reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x00403E60 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/go/00403E60-GOSoundSpeech.cpp at sha256 953cf7709789c52d3011e9c5e4fdf94b7fd866bd04ee88041935281e61e4f00b (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t GOSoundSpeech(long param_1, int32_t param_2, float param_3);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

checks.detail: BN (long double arg1 @ st0, int32_t arg2, float arg3 @ 0xc). The candidate (long param_1, int32_t param_2, float param_3) reads the frame from param_3=[E+0xc] (correct) but writes the result record and returns param_2=[E+8] (the argc slot) instead of param_1=[E+4].The retail result slot is [E+4] (arg1 in BN's model). signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(long double arg1 @ st0, int32_t arg2, float arg3 @ 0xc)" at 0x00403E60; radare2 recovers "fcn.00403e60 (int32_t arg_28h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x00403E60 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame.
